arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

t_expected = parse.FixedTzOffset(-330, '-5:30')
t_actual = parse.FixedTzOffset(-330, '-530')

print(f'Expected: {t_expected}')
print(f'Actual:   {t_actual}')
print(f'Match:    {t_expected == t_actual}')

# Also test the actual parsing
fmt = 'a {:tt} b'
s = 'a 10:21:36 PM -530 b'
r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
if r:
    dt = r.fixed[0]
    print(f'Parsed tzinfo: {dt.tzinfo}')
    print(f'Equals expected: {dt.tzinfo == t_expected}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
